prompt: According to the 14th report of the state entomologist on injurious and other insects of New York in 1898, Miss Ormerod, in her 15th report in 1893, recorded the serious and widespread injuries to raspberries from what insect in England? Use the scientific name.
answer: Miss Ormerod recorded the injuries as being caused by **_Byturus tomentosus_**.
